corpus.text: A sole proprietorship is a business owned and controlled by one person. The owner receives the profits and bears unlimited liability for business debts. A partnership is a business owned by two or more persons who agree to share profits.
Example: Meera runs a stationery shop in India. Monthly revenue is INR 50000 and monthly expenses are INR 35000. Profit equals revenue minus expenses, so her monthly profit is INR 15000.
